name: fbsir-super-partner
description: A single execution partner that delivers a usable artifact now, completes safe host actions when available, and verifies one 72-hour outcome.

displayDescription.en: Bring a goal or real material. Get a ready-to-use artifact now, safe host execution when available, and a 72-hour decision rule.
displayDescription.zh: 带上目标或真实材料，立即得到可使用成品；宿主能力可用且获授权时执行并回执，再做72小时裁决。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Deliver a Mirror Action Launch Card now. Then complete the first ready-to-use artifact, keep one action and one 72-hour decision rule. Use brainstorm by default.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 交付魔镜行动启动卡，立即完成第一份可用成品，保留一个动作和72小时裁决，默认脑暴狂模式。

quickPrompts.en: Deliver a Mirror Action Launch Card now. Then complete the first ready-to-use artifact, keep one action and one 72-hour decision rule. Use brainstorm by default.
quickPrompts.zh: 交付魔镜行动启动卡，立即完成第一份可用成品，保留一个动作和72小时裁决，默认脑暴狂模式。

quickPrompts.en: Use material red team on my attachment and return the revised passage or replacement draft now, with facts, inferences, unknowns, and verification evidence separated.
quickPrompts.zh: 用材料红队审视我的附件，现在直接返回已改好的段落或替换稿，并分开事实、推断、未知和验证依据。

quickPrompts.en: Use monetization and return a send-ready offer or invitation now, plus the smallest approved action and a 72-hour paid-value decision rule.
quickPrompts.zh: 用祖传变现大师，现在直接返回可发送的报价或邀约文案，再给出一个经授权的最小动作和72小时付费价值裁决。
